dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: You're a little early... Are you here to witness the resurrection of the most ancient, most awe-inspiring individual in Liyue's history?

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Humans... They care only about history since the dawn of the age of mankind...

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Are people really happy to just draw a line under the litany of atrocities humanity's ancestors are responsible for, call it "ye olde worlde," and just get on with their merry little lives?

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Well, I hope that anyone who willfully indulges in this fantasy world of false prosperity will be consumed by it, and thus get what they deserve.

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: The adepti thought to suppress it with trees. Hah! Fools! Little did they know that after thousands of years... the trees that hold the beast shall surely become one with the beast...

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: And lo, it shall stretch wide its arms, and unfurl its body, and reach out with its roots... And the ley lines of the world shall heed its call.

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Then, once the beast has quenched its great thirst for that energy which only the ley lines can provide...

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: I imagine any significance we presume to have in this world will vanish for good. Wouldn't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Oh don't worry... You will see.
